mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.ip,a.status,a.AUTH_STATUS as authStatus,a.PING_STATUS as pingStatus,a.remark,a.MASK, a.GATEWAY,a.PING_DATE as pingDate,b.NAME as assetName,b.ID as assetId FROM M_IP_INFO a left join ASSET b on (a.ip = b.ip or a.ip = b.ip2 or a.ip = b.IPMI_IP) WHERE a.NET_WORK_ADDRESS_ID = #{netWorkId}
